subject: TerraHealth procurement: PO requirements, invoice cadence, and packaging constraints
messages:
From: TerraHealth Procurement <procurement@terrahealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Taylor <btaylor@terrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding and PO / invoicing constraints for Redwood pilot

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looked promising. Before we can proceed with the pilot we need to confirm a few procurement items so our AP team can route a Purchase Order. Please confirm that Redwood can accommodate the following: 

- Formal PO required on all invoices (we will provide a master PO template).
- Net 75 payment terms (company policy).
- Consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity (we do not accept multiple weekly invoices).
- Include TerraHealth Tax ID and BU code on invoice header; invoices must reference the PO ID.
- Vendor setup requires W-9 and signed SOW prior to first invoice.

Attached is our PO template and the fields our ERP will validate. If any of the above are a hard blocker, let us know today so we can decide next steps.

Best,

Alicia Gomez
Procurement Manager, TerraHealth
[Attachment: TerraHealth_PO_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@terrahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Taylor <btaylor@terrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and PO / invoicing constraints for Redwood pilot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can comply with PO references and consolidated monthly invoices. A few clarifying questions so I can loop in ops and finance: 

1) Net 75 is unusual for our standard terms. Would TerraHealth consider Net 45 with a 2% early-payment discount? If not, we need to confirm revenue recognition cadence with finance.
2) For the first invoice we can provide the signed SOW and vendor paperwork; after that we can switch to monthly consolidated invoices referencing the PO ID — is that acceptable to your AP?
3) Which billing BU code should be included on the invoice (please paste exact token so our invoicing engine maps correctly)?

I'll pull in Vanessa from renewals and Priyom from billing to confirm the operational workaround.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0182
[Sent from Redwood mailbox]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: TerraHealth procurement: PO requirements, invoice cadence, and packaging constraints

Dylan / Priyom — forwarding TerraHealth's ask. Quick internal plan:

- PO requirement: yes — we accept PO number on header and will add custom PO field in our invoicing metadata.
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices — fine. We should set invoice date to the last day of month to match their AR runs.
- Net terms: TerraHealth asked Net75. Recommend we offer two options in the commercial: (A) Net75 standard (no additional discount) or (B) Net45 + 2% early-pay discount (limited to first 6 months of pilot). Finance impact: Net75 increases DSO and affects cash flow; early-pay discount requires SOW/commit confirmation.
- Packaging/pricing: TerraHealth will be purchasing dedicated pilot capacity + usage overrun. Propose we lock pilot price on the attached Pricing_Card_Q2.xlsx and add a 3-month ramp clause in the SOW.

Action items for this thread:
1) Priyom: can billing system accept "PO: <alphanumeric>" and map to our invoice header fields? Also confirm how we will include Tax ID and BU code.
2) Dylan: ask Alicia for the exact BU code token and whether AP will accept a single PO referencing multiple invoices.
3) I will prepare a one-page amendment offering the Net45/2% concession and a fallback to Net75 if not accepted.

Attachments: SOW-v2.docx (draft with ramp clause), Pricing_Card_Q2.xlsx

— Vanessa
Director, Customer Renewals, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@terrahealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Taylor <btaylor@terrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding and PO / invoicing constraints for Redwood pilot

Dylan / Vanessa — thanks, that framework is helpful. A few responses and decisions from AP: 

- BU code: "TH-BU-07-CLIN" — please include exactly as typed in invoice header.
- We can accept consolidated monthly invoices referencing a single master PO. We need the first invoice to include the signed SOW and completed vendor packet.
- Net terms: our legal policy prefers Net75. We can escalate to Treasury for Net60 in exchange for a 1% early-pay incentive, but Net45 requires executive sign-off that will delay the pilot. Can Redwood proceed with Net60 + 1% discount?
- Please send back an example invoice with PO reference once you have vendor setup to confirm header mapping.

If Redwood can send a PO-anchored invoice sample and the amended SOW (with ramp clause), we'll queue the vendor setup.

Best,

Alicia Gomez
Procurement Manager, TerraHealth
